description:
T1 London Plane - Reduce crown height by 3 Metres and reduce spread by up to 4 Metres - to balance crown and leave clearance from surrounding buildings.
T2 Lime - Reduce crown height and spread by 3 Metres, thin crown by 10% and lift crown to 4 Metres - to balance crown and maintain tree.
T3 Lime - Reduce crown height and spread by 3 Metres, thin crown by 10% and lift crown to 4 Metres - to balance crown and maintain tree.
T4 Holly - Reduce crown height by 3 Metres - to prevent loosing surrounding trees due to encroachment.
T5 Ash - Reduce spread of west side of crown by 3 Metres - to balance crown and reduce encroachment to neighbouring trees.
T6 Cherry - Reduce spread of west side of crown by 3 Metres - to balance crown and reduce encroachment to neighbouring trees.
T7 Aspen - Reduce crown height and spread by 3 Metres - to balance overgrown crown.
G1 Row of 11 x Beech - Reduce height of all trees by 3.5 Metres - These trees have been trained to wires from installation and require maintenance to be kept in condition.
